skeletor.title: Skeletor
skeletor.subtitle: Boss
skeletor.description: This is the Skeletor. The King of all cursed bones!

emitter.title: Emitter
emitter.subtitle: Boss
emitter.description: This is the Emitter. The God of technology!

inferno.title: Inferno
inferno.subtitle: Boss
inferno.description: Here is the Hell. I am, Inferno

knowledgeBook.title: Book of Will
knowledgeBook.subtitle: Source of Will
knowledgeBook.description: Focus your mind on the numbers and earn the Will to travel the world.

hero.title: Hero
hero.tableRule: Three heart tokens. Holds one item in each hand. On your turn take 20 Will on the counter; spend it on steps, strikes, shields and items.

skeleton-warrior.title: Skeleton Warrior
skeleton-warrior.tableRule: Three half-hearts, bone blade and bone buckler. Walks the shortest way to you keeping 7 Will, strikes once, then steps one hex away. Defends with one shield on the ring hex nearest you.

skeleton-king.title: Skeleton King
skeleton-king.tableRule: Eight half-hearts, too heavy to push. Fights like a warrior, but if you stand between him and a saw he pushes you onto it instead of striking (once per turn).

skeleton-archer.title: Skeleton Archer
skeleton-archer.tableRule: Two half-hearts, no shield. Shoots from 2 or 3 hexes; the arrow card covers the three hexes facing the archer. Never shoots point-blank: steps away first, and strikes in melee only when boxed in.

sword.title: Sword
sword.tableRule: Weapon. A strike costs 7 Will and deals one heart. One strike per turn with this hand.

dagger.title: Dagger
dagger.tableRule: Weapon. A strike costs 7 Will and deals half a heart. One strike per turn with this hand.

wooden-shield.title: Wooden Shield
wooden-shield.tableRule: Lets you place up to two shield tokens on the ring when defending, 4 Will each.

health-potion.title: Health Potion
health-potion.tableRule: Use it from a hand for 3 Will: take back one heart, never above your maximum. Remove the card afterwards.

bone-blade.title: Bone Blade
bone-blade.tableRule: Enemy weapon. Deals half a heart.

bone-buckler.title: Bone Buckler
bone-buckler.tableRule: Enemy shield. One shield token when defending.

king-cleaver.title: King's Cleaver
king-cleaver.tableRule: Enemy weapon. Deals half a heart.

king-shield.title: King's Shield
king-shield.tableRule: Enemy shield. Two shield tokens when defending.

bone-bow.title: Bone Bow
bone-bow.tableRule: Enemy weapon. Shoots 2 to 3 hexes for half a heart; not point-blank unless boxed in.

rubble.title: Rubble
rubble.tableRule: A step onto rubble costs 5 Will instead of 3.

ledge.title: Ledge
ledge.tableRule: Climbing up costs 5 Will, stepping down 3. A strike from a ledge onto a lower hex deals half a heart more. Pushed off a ledge: lose half a heart.

oil.title: Oil
oil.tableRule: Whatever is pushed onto oil slides one more hex the same way, if that hex is free.

saw.title: Saw
saw.tableRule: Entering it starts the 5-second hourglass. Right answer: no harm. Wrong or late: lose half of your hearts, rounded up to a half. Then you are thrown back off the saw.

boulder.title: Boulder
boulder.tableRule: Blocks its hex. Weight 2: only a force of 2 can push or pull it.

lone-skeleton.title: Lone Skeleton
lone-skeleton.tableRule: One skeleton warrior. A good first fight.

skeleton-pack.title: Skeleton Pack
skeleton-pack.tableRule: Two skeleton warriors fighting side by side.

archer-watch.title: Archer Watch
archer-watch.tableRule: Two archers on guard. Step into their watched hexes and they ambush you.

bone-court.title: Bone Court
bone-court.tableRule: The skeleton king with two warriors. The king strikes hard.
